name: Accept King Roald’s request to check on Drezel

evidence.note: Speak to King Roald at Varrock Palace.

name: Knock on the Paterdomus temple door

evidence.note: The voices inside ask the player to kill the guardian.

name: Defeat the magic-immune temple guardian

evidence.note: Fight the level 30 guardian with melee or ranged equipment.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the guardian with melee or ranged combat and survive.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring a suitable weapon and food before retrying.

name: Report the guardian’s death to King Roald

evidence.note: Roald explains the guardian protected the temple and sends the player back.

name: Defeat a Zamorak monk for the golden key

evidence.note: Enter the temple, fight a level 30 monk and take the golden key.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Recover the golden key and return to the temple-door waypoint.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable combat equipment and recover the key before continuing.

name: Speak to Drezel through the cell door

evidence.note: Drezel explains how to contain the threat in the coffin.

name: Swap keys at the monument and fill a bucket

evidence.note: Exchange the golden key for the iron key and collect murky water. The route uses and retains the bucket.

name: Open the cell and pour blessed water over the coffin

evidence.note: Unlock the cell. Ask Drezel to bless the water, use it on the coffin, and speak to him again.

name: Buy and bank 50 pure essence

evidence.note: Budget 100 GP for the essence. Bank the purchase, then carry no more than 25 unnoted essence per handover trip.

name: Withdraw the first 25 unnoted pure essence

evidence.note: Take 25 unnoted essence and bank other items as necessary to free inventory space.

name: Give Drezel the first 25 unnoted essence

evidence.note: Speak to Drezel at the barrier and give him the first load. Bank the second load until this delivery is complete.

name: Give Drezel the remaining 25 unnoted essence

evidence.note: Drezel takes the second load, awards Prayer XP and Wolfbane, and opens access to Morytania.

name: Buy a silver sickle

evidence.note: Budget 70 GP for a ready-made sickle. The route has no Crafting gate to make one.

name: Ask Drezel about Filliman Tarlock

evidence.note: Drezel grants access through the Mort Myre north gate during the quest.

name: Show Filliman his reflection and journal

evidence.note: Wear the ghostspeak amulet. Take the mirror from beneath the washing bowl and recover the journal from the grotto tree.

name: Return to Drezel for his blessing

evidence.note: Drezel blesses the player for Filliman’s rite.

name: Grow a fungus and set the three ritual stones

evidence.note: Cast Filliman’s spell beside a rotten log, pick the fungus, place it and the used scroll on their stones, then stand on the orange stone and speak to Filliman.

name: Have the Nature Spirit bless the silver sickle

evidence.note: Enter and search the grotto. Give Filliman the sickle and receive it back blessed, with a druid pouch.

name: Cast Bloom and charge the druid pouch

evidence.note: Cast Bloom beside swamp growths and fill the pouch. Refill Prayer as needed.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Collect enough growths to have three usable charges.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Refill Prayer and gather replacements if a ghast spends a charge.

name: Reveal and defeat three ghasts

evidence.note: Reveal and defeat three ghasts around the grotto. The planned route uses three charges.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat three revealed ghasts and return to the grotto entrance.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restore lost charges and bring suitable combat equipment if needed.

name: Speak to the Nature Spirit after the three kills

evidence.note: The Nature Spirit blesses the grotto and awards the quest’s fixed XP.

name: Buy the Myreque weapons, timber, nails and hammer

evidence.note: Budget 7,200 GP at the observed guide prices for six steel weapons, six planks, 225 nails and a hammer.

name: Buy five Mort myre fungi

evidence.note: Budget 600 GP for five fungi. Fill the pouch at Cyreg to protect these charges from the walk.

name: Speak to Vanstrom Klause in Canifis

evidence.note: Vanstrom asks for weapons for the Myreque.

name: Fill the druid pouch at Cyreg’s landing

evidence.note: Fill the pouch after the swamp crossing so the five charges are ready for Cyreg.

name: Collect swamp growths and fill the druid pouch near Cyreg

evidence.note: Use Bloom in the nearby swamp. Return to the landing with five additional charges.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Have five usable charges available at the landing.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Refill Prayer and replace charges spent by ghasts before talking to Cyreg.

name: Show Cyreg the supplies and take the boat to the Hollows

evidence.note: Show the charged pouch and all six steel weapons. Give Cyreg three planks, pay 10 coins, take the boat and walk to the bridge tree.

name: Repair the three parts of the rope bridge and cross

evidence.note: Climb the tree, use one plank and 75 nails on each of three sections, cross and approach Curpile.

name: Answer Curpile’s questions and enter the hideout

evidence.note: Answer the questions about the boatman and the Myreque. Enter the wooden doors and the hidden alcove leading to Veliaf.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Answer all questions correctly and reach Veliaf.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: If sent back to the boat, return over the repaired bridge and retry the questions.

name: Speak to the Myreque and give Veliaf the weapons

evidence.note: Speak to Veliaf and introduce yourself to all five members, then deliver the six weapons to Veliaf. The hellhound encounter follows.

name: Defeat the Skeleton Hellhound

evidence.note: Use a suitable combat setup for the level 97 Skeleton Hellhound. Ranged or magic can use a safe spot near the chair.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Skeleton Hellhound and return to Veliaf.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring appropriate equipment, ammunition or runes and food before retrying.

name: Ask Veliaf how to leave and use the Canifis tunnel

evidence.note: Speak to Veliaf, leave the alcove and climb the north ladder to the trapdoor behind the Canifis tavern.

name: Report to the Stranger in Canifis

evidence.note: Award five sets of 600 XP, two quest points and the quick route to Mort’ton.

name: Inspect the frozen guide and offer to make the cake

evidence.note: The Gypsy directs the player to Wizard Traiborn after checking the prerequisites and Cooking.

name: Buy an egg, flour, milk and a cake tin

evidence.note: Budget 290 GP for the four ordinary tradeable items.

name: Pass Traiborn’s three quizzes and mix the enchanted ingredients

evidence.note: Pass the egg’s NPC quiz, the milk’s general questions and the flour’s item questions, then mix the enchanted ingredients in the tin.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Pass all three quizzes and have the raw cake in the tin.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Repeat any failed quiz with Traiborn before leaving the tower.

name: Cook the guidance cake on the Lumbridge range

evidence.note: Cook at the range. The reward review tracks the fixed handover XP and records the incidental Cooking XP for follow-up.

name: Give the guidance cake to the frozen Lumbridge Guide

evidence.note: Award one quest point, 2,500 Cooking XP and 2,500 Magic XP.

name: Ask Morgan about the vampyre

evidence.note: Morgan sends the player to Dr Harlow.

name: Get garlic from Morgan’s upstairs cupboard

evidence.note: Climb the stairs, search the cupboard and return to Morgan’s waypoint. Garlic weakens Count Draynor.

name: Buy a beer and ask Dr Harlow how to slay the vampyre

evidence.note: Buy a beer from the Blue Moon Inn bartender for 2 GP and give it to Harlow. He supplies the stake.

name: Buy a hammer

evidence.note: Budget 80 GP for a hammer if one is not already carried.

name: Defeat Count Draynor and finish with the stake

evidence.note: Open the coffin and defeat the level 34 vampyre with a hammer and stake carried. Garlic helps with the fight.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat Count Draynor and confirm the stake completes the quest.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring appropriate combat equipment and food, and retrieve a replacement stake from Harlow if needed.

name: Ask Veronica about Ernest

evidence.note: Veronica asks the player to find Ernest inside the manor.

name: Speak to Professor Oddenstein upstairs

evidence.note: Learn which three machine parts are missing.

name: Collect and poison the fish food and take a spade

evidence.note: Collect fish food upstairs and poison on the ground floor, then mix them. Pick up the spade in the east room if needed.

name: Retrieve the pressure gauge from the fountain

evidence.note: Use the poisoned food to clear the piranhas and search the fountain.

name: Dig up the closet key and retrieve the rubber tube

evidence.note: Dig at the compost heap west of the manor, then unlock the ground-floor closet and take the tube. The skeleton can be avoided.

name: Solve the basement lever maze and take the oil can

evidence.note: Toggle the six levers to open the west room and return to the ladder after taking the oil can.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Reach the west room and return with the oil can.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Read the current lever positions and work through the doors again if the expected route is blocked.

name: Give the three machine parts to Professor Oddenstein

evidence.note: Oddenstein restores Ernest. Build 242 fresh completion includes a 500 XP lamp.

name: Buy cadava berries

evidence.note: Budget 80 GP for one set of cadava berries.

name: Ask Romeo about Juliet

evidence.note: Romeo sends the player to Juliet.

name: Talk to Juliet and take her message

evidence.note: Juliet gives a message for Romeo.

name: Give Romeo Juliet’s message

evidence.note: Romeo directs the player to Father Lawrence.

name: Ask Father Lawrence about the marriage

evidence.note: Father Lawrence suggests the cadava potion.

name: Give the Apothecary the cadava berries

evidence.note: The Apothecary makes the potion without an additional coin charge.

name: Give Juliet the cadava potion

evidence.note: Juliet drinks the potion in the cutscene.

name: Tell Romeo what happened to Juliet

evidence.note: Finish the final dialogue and cutscene. Build 242 fresh completion includes a 500 XP lamp.

name: Ask Redbeard Frank about treasure

evidence.note: Frank asks for a bottle of Karamjan rum.

name: Buy rum and hide it in Luthas’s banana shipment

evidence.note: Buy one bottle, ask Luthas for work, pick ten bananas, conceal the rum in the shipping crate and fill it with the bananas. Tell Luthas for the 30 GP wage.

name: Wear a white apron and recover the rum from Wydin’s crate

evidence.note: Collect the apron from the Port Sarim fishing shop, ask Wydin for a job and search the imported crate in the back room.

name: Give Redbeard Frank the recovered rum

evidence.note: Frank exchanges the bottle for his chest key.

name: Unlock Frank’s chest at the inn and read the clue

evidence.note: Climb the inn stairs, use the key on the chest and read the message.

name: Dig up the treasure in Falador Park

evidence.note: Dig at the cross, deal with the level 4 gardener and dig again for the treasure. Build 242 awards 800 Cooking XP.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the interfering gardener with an appropriate combat setup and dig up the treasure.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Return with a spade and a suitable weapon, and finish the dig.

name: Withdraw the second 25 unnoted pure essence

evidence.note: Take 25 unnoted essence and bank other items as necessary to free inventory space.

name: Buy a Salve graveyard teleport tablet

evidence.note: Budget 4,750 GP. Breaking the tablet requires Priest in Peril.
